title: Verifiable Efficiency Limits of Innate LLM Planning in Sliding Puzzles
abstract: arXiv:2610.36415v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-assisted planning success can reflect external search and verification, leaving a model's unaided planning ability unresolved. We isolate innate planning through complete plans generated in one response without tools or execution feedback. We propose a verifiable framework that decomposes success-weighted plan efficiency as $\mathrm{SPE}=R\times Q\times E$: execution reliability, planning coordination among legal plans, and action economy among completed plans. Trajectory replay and certified optima verify these factors; the joint score includes unsuccessful attempts. We evaluate 8,400 full-plan outputs from seven model conditions on $4\times4$ sliding puzzles, controlling exact horizon and obstacle count in the primary cohort. Models that complete every trial still become less economical at longer horizons, while higher efficiency among completed plans can coexist with poor goal attainment. translated_title: 滑块拼图中大语言模型内在规划能力的可验证效率极限
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.36415v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：借助工具完成的规划成功可能反映的是外部搜索与验证的作用，从而使模型自身无辅助的规划能力仍悬而未决。我们通过在不使用工具、不依赖执行反馈的情况下于单次响应中生成的完整规划，来分离模型的内在规划能力。我们提出了一个可验证的框架，将成功加权的规划效率分解为 SPE = R × Q × E：即执行可靠性、合法规划之间的规划协调性，以及已完成规划之间的行动经济性。轨迹回放与经认证的最优解用于验证这些因素；联合评分还将失败的尝试纳入考量。我们在 4×4 滑块拼图上评估了七种模型条件下的 8,400 个完整规划输出，并在主要队列中精确控制了步长视野与障碍数量。结果显示，即使能够完成全部试次的模型，在更长视野下仍会变得不够经济高效，而已完成规划中较高的效率也可能与较差的目标达成率并存。SPE 能够区分整体能力层级……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出可验证的 SPE = R × Q × E 框架，将大语言模型在滑块拼图上的内在规划效率分解为执行可靠性、规划协调性与行动经济性，并发现即便模型能完成全部任务，其效率在更长视野下仍会下降，且高效率可与低目标达成率并存。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a verifiable framework decomposing innate LLM planning efficiency into SPE = R × Q × E (reliability, quality, economy), revealing on 4×4 sliding puzzles that even fully completing models become less economical at longer horizons, and high efficiency can coexist with poor goal attainment.
